changes.description: Kiro CLI V3 is now the default experience, with workflows, specs, cloud sessions and more
The Classic experience is retired; new capabilities are built in the terminal UI
Inline shell autocomplete and the CLI desktop app are retired
Refreshed look for the welcome screen, startup notices and What's new, without the startup tip
The `/fullscreen` scroll-to-bottom pill has a dark fill, lights up on hover, and its dot turns green on new messages
[V3] An answer cut off at the model's output limit now says so and suggests asking Kiro to continue
[V3] Idle sessions use far less CPU tracking the engine's process tree
